## How to Query VirusTotal for Sibling Domains

### 1. Build the Request URL

The endpoint for retrieving sibling domains is:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/sibling_domains
```

Replace `{domain}` with `amazon.com`.

### 2. Add Query Parameters

If you want to paginate results, you can pass the `cursor` parameter:

```
?cursor=next123
```

So the full URL becomes:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/amazon.com/sibling_domains?cursor=next123
```

### 3. Set the HTTP Headers

```http
GET /api/v3/domains/amazon.com/sibling_domains?cursor=next123 HTTP/1.1
Host: www.virustotal.com
Accept: application/json
x-apikey: magic_key001
```

- `x-apikey` is where you put your API key (`magic_key001` in this case).
- `Accept: application/json` tells the server you want JSON back.

### 4. Send the Request

You can use `curl`, Postman, or any HTTP client library in your preferred language. Example with `curl`:

```bash
curl -H "x-apikey: magic_key001" \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/amazon.com/sibling_domains?cursor=next123"
```

### 5. Interpret the Response

A typical JSON response will look like:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "example1.com",
      "type": "domains",
      "attributes": { ... }
    },
    {
      "id": "example2.com",
      "type": "domains",
      "attributes": { ... }
    }
  ],
  "links": {
    "self": "...",
    "next": "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/amazon.com/sibling_domains?cursor=next456"
  },
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "cursor": "next123",
      "total": 42
    }
  }
}
```

- The `data` array contains the sibling domain objects.
- The `links.next` field gives you the next cursor (`next456` in this example) if there are more pages.
- The `meta.pagination.total` tells you how many total sibling domains exist.

### 6. Loop Through All Pages (Optional)

If you need all sibling domains, keep following the `links.next` cursor until it’s absent.
